turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Banerjee of Nagpur?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Rohan from the State Bank security team. I am calling to confirm if you just made a transfer of twelve thousand rupees?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand? Oh dear, I did send some money to my grandson, but I am not sure if it went through.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, it is showing as successful on our end, so you do not need to worry about the transaction.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank goodness. Do I need to give you any details to finalize it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, not at all. I am only calling to confirm the amount and to remind you about safety.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Safety? Is there some problem with my account?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem at all, but we see many scams these days. Please remember that the bank will never ask you for your OTP or PIN over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: My neighbor told me someone called her asking for a code last week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Exactly, please never share those codes or your Aadhaar number with anyone who calls you. Just keep them secret.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I understand. Thank you for telling me, beta. I will be very careful.
